title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P02: Plan B: water / Layla's scarf / Plan C: pep talk
summary: A giant bucket drenches Layla. She starts knitting (B-story). Sam coaches the seed.

lines.tts: [excited] Plants love water. So... [shouting] maximum water!
lines.note: WS: Sam holds a bucket bigger than his torso. Anticipation lean, heave on 'maximum'; splash arcs over the mound and drenches Layla.
MCU Layla dripping, darker wet colour.
Bucket still upside down in his hands.
She unfolds a little stool, sits, takes out knitting needles + a tiny bit of scarf. B-story starts.

lines.text: Winter?! How do you *live* like this?
lines.tts: [horrified] Winter?! How do you live like this?
lines.note: CU Sam, hands on his head.

lines.tts: [serene, slowly] Slowly. Knit one, purl one.

lines.text: Okay. Plan C. Every champion needs a *coach*.
lines.tts: [determined] Okay. Plan C. Every champion needs a coach.
lines.note: Sam puts on a cap + whistle (tweet SFX), kneels by the mound like a coach.

lines.text: Listen, little buddy. You are strong. You are tall.
lines.tts: [inspirational, building] Listen, little buddy. You are strong. You are tall.
lines.note: MS low angle; an inspirational swell builds under the line.
Fist up. Record scratch -> WS: nothing happened; crickets; Pip tilts its head.

lines.text: I think it's taking a nap.
lines.tts: [dry] I think it's taking a nap.

lines.note: He blows the whistle at the mound (tweet). Smash cut.

beats: OPEN (0-4 s): Sam fills a bucket bigger than his torso with a garden hose; the level rises slowly; he taps his foot (impatience motif), glares at the hose.
l2 gap: the splash lands — Layla drenched, drips, a beat of silence; Pip shakes water off on the fence.
l11 gap: cap + whistle go on, he kneels like a coach.
l14 gap: record scratch, crickets, Pip tilts its head.
